proposal.summary: Draytek Vigor Routers and other devices use hardcoded encryption keys, allowing attackers to bind devices to their own accounts and create licenses.
proposal.affected_product: Draytek Vigor Routers firmware versions below 3.9.6/4.2.4, Access Points firmware versions below v1.4.0, Switches firmware versions below 2.6.7, Myvigor firmware versions below 2.3.2
proposal.cwe_quote: The use of hard-coded cryptographic keys.

AV.quote: allows attackers to bind any affected device to their own account.

PR.quote: allows attackers to bind any affected device to their own account.

C.quote: Attackers are then able to create WCF and DrayDDNS licenses and synchronize them from the website.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the use of hardcoded encryption keys and implement a patch to remove them.
